name: selfhosted-analytics
description: Privacy-first, self-hosted product analytics platform (NestJS monorepo)

scripts.dev:all: node init && concurrently -n auth,ingest,stream,query,alert,dash,web -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,white,red "npm run dev -w @analytics/auth" "npm run dev -w @analytics/ingestion" "npm run dev -w @analytics/stream-processor" "npm run dev -w @analytics/query-api" "npm run dev -w @analytics/alerting" "npm run dev -w @analytics/dashboard-config" "npm run dev -w @analytics/web"
